lines: Gaze on śakti — breath held soft and slight:
this is the sign, and raising waits beyond this rite.
sanskrit_cite: tāmevālokayec chaktiṃ manāk kumbhakavṛttinā / etal lakṣaṇam uddiṣṭam utthāpanam ataḥ param

lines: Breathe out the practiced breath, and speak the seed;
see her awake, straight as a staff — the Goddess indeed.
sanskrit_cite: juṣadrecakavṛttyā tu mantraṃ caiva samuccaret / prabuddhāṃ cintayecchaktiṃ daṇḍavat parameśvarīm

lines: From the base's middle risen, she holds the central way —
this is raising sealed, and awakening waits beyond.
sanskrit_cite: ādhāramadhyādāyātā suṣumnāmārgam āśritā / utthāpanaṃ samākhyātaṃ bodhanaṃ paratastathā

lines: From the Bulb, pierce the navel, then the grandsire of the heart;
the unfailing in the throat, Rudra face to face where palate arches.
sanskrit_cite: kandastho vedhayen nābhiṃ tato hṛtsthaṃ pitāmaham / kaṇṭhasthamacyutaṃ sākṣādrudraṃ tālutale sthitam

lines: Īśa between the brows, Sadāśiva at the crown's door —
wake them, rise swift to the shore that rests on nothing: Śiva.
sanskrit_cite: bhruvormadhyagataṃ tv īśaṃ brahmadvāre sadāśivam / bodhayitvā vrajed āśu padaṃ cānāśritaṃ śivam

lines: This awakening stands declared. Now the wheels' repose:
a petal by nature — blazing, flowing, like the still sky.
sanskrit_cite: etadbodhanam uddiṣṭaṃ cakraviśrāmaṇaṃ tataḥ / svābhāvikaṃ dalaṃ dīptaṃ dravaṃ sthiranabhopamam

lines: Nectar, crest, śakti-brahmā, and the drop-sound's tone —
the twelvefold wheel proclaimed, by tradition known.
sanskrit_cite: amṛtaṃ śekharaṃ caiva śaktirbrahmā tathaiva ca / bindunādaṃ tathā proktaṃ cakradvādaśakaṃ kila

lines: She pierces in her order, wheel in wheel, each breath of time;
she rests, the Great Goddess: the wheel-rest sublime.
sanskrit_cite: vedhayantī kramāc chaktiścakre cakre pratikṣaṇam / viśramet sā mahādevī cakraviśrāma uttamaḥ

lines: First the heart will tremble, then the palate-gate —
the head spins: this is the sight's crossing-state.
sanskrit_cite: hṛdayaṃ kampate pūrvaṃ tālukadvārameva ca / śiraśca bhramate tasya dṛṣṭisaṃkrāntilakṣaṇam

lines: Each single limb it whirls, each joint of limb and part;
his heart churns round, by true knowledge's art.
sanskrit_cite: ekaikaṃ bhramayaty aṅgam aṅgapratyaṅgasaṃdhiṣu / ghūrṇate hṛdayaṃ cāsya samyagvidyāprabhāvataḥ
